title: Format R source code — format_text
text: format_text() formats one R source string returns result. format_file() formats one UTF-8 file place reports invisibly whether contents changed. functions use formatter embedded arity-formatter Rust crate; invoke arity CLI discover arity.toml file.

title: Format R source code — format_text
code: format_text(   text,   line_width = 80L,   indent_width = 2L,   line_ending = c("auto", "lf", "crlf", "native"),   roxygen_markdown = FALSE,   verify = TRUE )  format_file(   path,   line_width = 80L,   indent_width = 2L,   line_ending = c("auto", "lf", "crlf", "native"),   roxygen_markdown = FALSE,   verify = TRUE )

title: Format R source code — format_text
text: text non-missing character scalar containing valid UTF-8 R source code. Strings declared encoding converted UTF-8. line_width Maximum output line width, 1 1000. indent_width Number spaces per indentation level, 1 1000. line_ending Output line-ending policy. "auto" preserves style first source line ending, "lf" "crlf" force style, "native" uses current platform's convention. roxygen_markdown Whether roxygen blocks without explicit @md @noMd directive parsed markdown mode. verify Whether verify syntax preservation, ordinary comment preservation, idempotence formatting. path non-missing character scalar naming UTF-8 file. contents treated R source regardless file extension.

title: Format R source code — format_text
text: format_text() returns character scalar. format_file() invisibly returns TRUE file changed FALSE otherwise.

title: Format R source code — format_text
code: format_text("x<-(1+2)*3^4\n") #> [1] "x <- (1 + 2) * 3^4\n" path <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("x<-1", path) format_file(path) readLines(path) #> [1] "x <- 1" unlink(path)
